functions.name: authored_pull_requests
functions.description: PRs authored by the selected personal user across visible repositories, including repositories the user does not own. Each row's author must match the canonical user or the query fails. This is independent of owned-repository inventory.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: One personal GitHub user login, including work in repositories owned by other accounts.

metrics.name: authored_pr_count
metrics.comment: All visible open and closed PRs authored by the selected user, regardless of who owns each repository.

metrics.name: authored_merged_pr_count
metrics.comment: Visible PRs authored by the selected user with a non-NULL merge timestamp.

metrics.name: authored_median_merge_hours
metrics.comment: Exact continuous median elapsed UTC hours from creation to merge for visible authored PRs; NULL for an empty merged cohort.

metrics.name: authored_pr_active_days
metrics.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

metrics.name: authored_pr_repository_count
metrics.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

derived_fields.name: merge_hours
derived_fields.comment: Elapsed UTC milliseconds between creation and merge divided by 3600000; NULL until merged.

derived_fields.name: authored_pr_created_day
derived_fields.comment: Gregorian UTC date of creation for a PR authored by the selected user.

derived_fields.name: authored_pr_merged_day
derived_fields.comment: Gregorian UTC date of merge for an authored PR; NULL until merged.

derived_fields.name: authored_pr_created_week
derived_fields.comment: UTC Gregorian week of creation; weeks begin Monday.

derived_fields.name: authored_pr_created_month
derived_fields.comment: UTC Gregorian month of creation; weeks begin Monday.

derived_fields.name: authored_pr_title_category
derived_fields.comment: Transparent classification from case-insensitive conventional title prefixes docs:, fix:, feat:, refactor:, test:. First matching rule wins; other titles are unclassified. This describes title wording, not author intent; original title is available as evidence.
